title.en: An Act to Make An Appropriation for a General Anti-Cholera Vaccination Campaign throughout the Philippine Islands, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The sum of one hundred and fifty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the
Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be disbursed by the Philippine Health Service for an
immediate anti-cholera vaccination campaign throughout the Philippine Islands: Provided, That of this
appropriation, a sum not to exceed twenty-five thousand pesos, shall be available to reimburse the Health
Service for the sum already disbursed for the anti-cholera campaign from its appropriation for the current year
provided for in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-eight.

Any balance of this appropriation remaining free or unexpended on December thirty-first,
nineteen hundred and thirty, shall revert to the unappropriated funds in the Insular Treasury and shall
thereafter not be available for expenditure except upon appropriation by the Legislature.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, August 2, 1930.
